title: Bring the warehouse typecheck configuration forward
prompt: The warehouse project has been upgraded to TypeScript 7.0.2 and its typecheck no longer passes. Update tsconfig.json only. Preserve strict checking of every source file, including future additions under src/, and keep the @app/* alias working. Do not modify source, dependencies or tests, disable checking or suppress diagnostics.
notes_private: Installed tsc 7.0.2 rejects baseUrl, moduleResolution node10 and ES5 target. Removing baseUrl also requires relative ./src/* paths. Reference uses bundler resolution and ES2022. Hidden tests compile fresh valid/invalid alias consumers and strictness probes in src, so noCheck or excluding source fails. This task intentionally edits config, not src, as specified.
